parameters: A bahay na bato packed with two hundred men. The air is
hot, still, charged. Aguinaldo is absent, currently at
Pasong Santol. Bonifacio stands at the front, thinner
than before. He demands an oath.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I will preside over this meeting. And before we begin,
I want you all to promise that you will accept whatever
decision the majority makes.
\n<Bonifacio>Do you promise?
A murmur of assent echoed throughout the hall. Men nod
Hands are raised.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>Good. Then let us begin.
\n<Jacinto Lumbreras>The voting has ended. I will now preside over the count.
\n<Jacinto Lumbreras>For President - Emilio Aguinaldo: one hundred and forty-
six. Andres Bonifacio: eighty. Mariano Trias: thirty.
\n<Jacinto Lumbreras>Vice-President - Mariano Trias.
Captain-General - Artemio Ricarte.
Director of War - Emiliano Riego de Dios.
Director of the Interior - Andres Bonifacio.
\n<Daniel Tirona>One moment. The Director of the Interior should have a
law degree. It is not fitting for an uneducated man.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>What are you getting at?
Bonifacio's hand moves to his revolver.
\n<Emilio Jacinto>Elder brother - not here. Not now.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I know my own abilities.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I did not study law — but I founded the Katipunan.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I wrote its rules. I led you — not with a diploma — but
with blood and sweat.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>In my capacity as chairman of this convention, and as
Presidente Supremo of the Most Venerable Katipunan of
the Sons of the People, which association is known and
acknowledged by all.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>I hereby declare null and void all matters approved in
this meeting.
He sets his revolver on the table. The sound of metal
on wood is loud in the silence.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>Whoever wants to follow me — come with me. But those
who stay here — you answer to your own conscience.
Andres Bonifacio walks out. Jacinto follows.
Then a handful of others. The door closes behind them.
You stand in the silent hall.
Choose your reaction:
Follow Bonifacio
Approach Aguinaldo
Stay with Trias
